Stated Claim / Post Context:
A man and a woman have been arrested on suspicion of murder after a woman’s body was found at a Liverpool hotel over the weekend.

Actual Article Body:
Police outside the White Star Line Hotel on James St in Liverpool(Image: Liverpool Echo)

A man and a woman have been arrested on suspicion of murder after a woman’s body was found at a Liverpool hotel over the weekend.

Police were called to The White Star Line Hotel in central Liverpool by North West Ambulance Service just after 3.20am on Saturday.

Paramedics had received a report that a 40-year-old woman had become unwell, the Liverpool Echo reports.

The woman was sadly pronounced dead at the scene, and her next of kin have been informed.

Police said the woman’s death is currently being treated as unexplained. The results of a post mortem, which has been carried out to establish the cause of her death, are being withheld while investigators await the results of a toxicology report.

A 47-year-old man from Kirkby and a 34-year-old woman from Liverpool have both been arrested on suspicion of murder. A 31-year-old man from Liverpool was arrested on suspicion of assisting an offender.

All three have been conditionally bailed while enquiries are ongoing.

Two police forensic vans were pictured outside The White Star Line Hotel yesterday evening.
